title: Gmail forward filter seems broken when tested by emailing yourself
symptoms: A test email to the forwarding mailbox never arrives at the destination
cause: Gmail does not deliver a message back to the account that sent it, so a self-sent test of a forward to that same account is suppressed.
fix: Test with a message sent from outside the destination account.
apply: Send the test from a different account or service, not from the forward's destination address.
